_comment: The ONE place that names the fonts. make-fonts.py reads this, writes assets/fonts/*.ttf and ui/fonts.slint (the Fonts global the whole design system uses). To change a font: change `package` (and `weights`, or `files` for static fonts) and `family`, then run the script. serif = titles, headings, card titles, the logo and button labels (Playfair Display as Kasboek Display); sans = data and running text (Lato 2.015 as Kasboek Sans); num = amounts and table numbers (Lato's default figures are tabular, so the same family). The OFL reserves the names Lato and Playfair Display, hence the new family names (see make-fonts.py).
